integrity_statement: The spectral decomposition is credited to prior literature; the new assertion is the uniform two-term ordered spectral counting law and its explicit logarithmic coefficient. Finite diagnostics supplement, not replace, the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive weight exponent; no uniformity at the zero-weight representation degeneration.
Requires the normalized rank-two matrix-ball Faraut–Korányi spectral decomposition; no claim of a third Weyl term.
Independent external mathematical audit and universal historical priority are not established.
title: A logarithmic second Weyl term at the critical Bergman-kernel trace boundary on a rank-two matrix ball
